$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase) pays. Every roll is
read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays and the Hoard is never empty; the
five after it are the chances at the Flaming Hallowed set's pieces (the Burning Jack Helm, the
Horseman's flaming breastplate, gauntlets and greaves, and the Flaming Jack Shield), the only
place his three flaming pieces come from; the last two are pieces of his graveyard to build
with, a tombstone and a ruins lantern like the ones that stand in it, which no recipe makes. His
plain armour pays from his daily Claim (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily.json). The Almanac's Hoard
grid (ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve.json) lists what this table pays, so
change the two together. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase
